titleZh: 純潔 ↔ 玷污｜白袍對墨汁
hook: chaste／immaculate 穿白袍進場，besmirch／blemish／defile 提墨汁——洗衣店老闆開始報價。
script: 潔淨隊：chaste／pristine／immaculate／unsullied。玷污隊：besmirch／blemish／defile／taint／sully。口令：白袍寫「無瑕」，墨汁寫「一滴定生死」。

members.speakLineEn: The poem kept a chaste tone, avoiding any flashy or suggestive imagery.
members.speakLineZh: 這首詩語氣純潔克制，避開一切華麗或挑逗的意象。

members.speakLineEn: Handed her his pristine white handkerchief.
Her notes were immaculate, with every date and source neatly underlined.
members.speakLineZh: 她的筆記毫無瑕疵，每個日期與出處都整齊畫線。

related.synonyms: speckless, spick-and-span, spic-and-span, spic, spick, spotless

members.speakLineEn: He hoped his reputation would remain unsullied after the messy campus rumor.
members.speakLineZh: 經歷校園謠言風波後，他仍希望自己的名聲保持未受玷污。

members.speakLineEn: The mountain spring tasted pure and cold after the long dusty hike.
members.speakLineZh: 走完漫長塵土飛揚的健行後，山泉嘗起來純淨又清涼。

members.speakLineEn: She kept a stainless record of honesty through four years of student government.
members.speakLineZh: 在四年學生自治會任內，她保持了無瑕疵的誠實紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: False posts tried to besmirch his name before the student election even began.
members.speakLineZh: 假貼文試圖在學生會選舉開始前就玷污他的名聲。

related.synonyms: defame, slander, smirch, asperse, denigrate, calumniate

members.speakLineEn: One late assignment should not leave a permanent blemish on an otherwise strong record.
members.speakLineZh: 一次遲交不該在原本優秀的成績單上留下永久污點。

related.synonyms: defect, mar, deface, disfigure, spot, flaw

members.speakLineEn: Dumping paint into the creek would defile the park that kids use every weekend.
members.speakLineZh: 把油漆倒進小溪，會污染孩子們每週末使用的公園。

related.synonyms: gorge, sully, corrupt, taint, cloud, tarnish

members.speakLineEn: A single unfair accusation can sully years of careful, honest work.
members.speakLineZh: 一則不公指控，就能玷污多年謹慎誠實的努力。

related.synonyms: defile, corrupt, taint, cloud, tarnish, stain

members.speakLineEn: Humidity made the silver trophies tarnish until they looked dull gray.
members.speakLineZh: 濕氣讓銀獎盃失去光澤，看起來變成暗灰色。

members.speakLineEn: The choir director handed each singer a clean whiterobe before the winter concert.
members.speakLineZh: 冬季音樂會前，合唱指揮發給每位歌手一件乾淨白袍。

members.speakLineEn: Blue ink spilled across the worksheet and stained half of the answer blanks.
members.speakLineZh: 藍色墨汁洒在學習單上，染髒了一半作答格。

members.speakLineEn: She dropped the muddy jerseys at the corner laundry after Saturday practice.
members.speakLineZh: 週六練習後，她把沾泥球衣送到街角洗衣店。

members.speakLineEn: A coffee spot on his white shirt made him change before the oral exam.
members.speakLineZh: 白襯衫上的咖啡斑點，讓他在口試前不得不換衣。

members.speakLineEn: Use mild bleach carefully if you want to remove the mold from the tile grout.
members.speakLineZh: 若要清除磁磚縫的霉斑，請小心使用溫和漂白水。

members.speakLineEn: She washed the paint off her hands with warm water and fragrant soap.
members.speakLineZh: 她用溫水和香皂把手上的顏料洗掉。

members.speakLineEn: Kids love to splash cold water at each other beside the outdoor fountain.
members.speakLineZh: 孩子們喜歡在戶外噴水池旁互相濺潑冷水。
